instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the Autodesk EAGLE graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run ULP scripts, command-line automation, Python, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only EAGLE native GUI tools, menus, and built-in save/export commands. Draw a closed `40 x 25 mm` board outline on layer `20` (`Dimension`) of `blank.brd`, and save the board as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd`. Rounded corners are optional. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.brd` parses as well-formed XML. 2. The file has at least 4 `<wire>` elements on layer `20`. 3. The bounding-box x-span of those layer-20 wire endpoints is `40 +/- 1 mm`. 4. The bounding-box y-span is `25 +/- 1 mm`. 5. The outline is closed: every wire endpoint, rounded to `0.001 mm`, is shared by at least 2 layer-20 wires. 6. The total `<element>` count is unchanged relative to the starter.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(8); w, h = pyautogui.size(); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 100, h/2 + 25); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 213, h/2 + 146); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 - 80, h/2 + 68); time.sleep(5)
